title: Let task-sync export and import carry tasks imported from an external source, so Comovo's Beads-imported tasks sync between hosts
outcome: Let task-sync export and import carry tasks imported from an external source, so Comovo's Beads-imported tasks sync between hosts
acceptance: A project whose tasks were imported from an external source with an immutable source snapshot exports through task sync; export no longer refuses consistent Imported items, and still refuses an inconsistent origin and snapshot pair
An empty peer imports those documents with the same work ids and external references, holds them as ordinary tasks without a source snapshot, and re-exports identical shared documents

The original host keeps each item's Imported origin and its exact source snapshot through repeat exchanges in both directions, and a mixed graph of imported and native parents and prerequisites round-trips
The task-sync documentation describes externally imported tasks as shared planning documents whose source snapshot stays host-local
